items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: Gorman told me the same thing. When I was always, he told me exactly the same thing.

ctx.x: I think that the way he's, like he said, we should play more soft and we should play more slow. I think that is right. Gorman told me the same thing. When I was always, he told me exactly the same thing. When the clarinet play in low reggae, the band should, so they should play not too loud. I don't like the way they play at the Preservation Hall. There's tunes and drums, solas, bass, band, and so it's all the time. It's awful boring.
What about Gorman now? He was organizing a band just before he died.
